about.title: Nice to meet you
p: We are Komi Komi Productions. We specialise in unforgettable experiences, birthday parties and concept events for kids and teens.
Our vision is simple: take the worlds, characters and trends kids love most and turn them into a rich, energetic, action-packed celebration.
From football tournaments and gaming parties such as Fortnite, Minecraft and Brawl Stars to trend events such as TikTok, K-pop, spa and Barbie, we handle the production from A to Z.

why.d: We design and produce every event around the dream of the bar or bat mitzvah child.

why.t: A full package in one place
why.d: DJ shows, professional hosts, themed decor, photo stations, food stands and sweets.
A trained team that makes sure every child takes part.

about.closing: With us every celebration is a production from another world. Get in touch and let's build the perfect event.

mitzvah.eyebrow: Bar mitzvah · Bat mitzvah · Event attractions
mitzvah.title: Celebrating and not sure where to start?
p: Here you will find everything about event production: attractions, candy bars, bar and bat mitzvah entrances, slow dances and duets, photo walls, light-up letters, magnet stations and more.
We come to style and organise the hall or garden with the newest attractions, so your guests have an unforgettable experience.
Event producer Liraz Bar accompanies you through every stage, from start to finish.

birthdays.text: Birthday activities for ages 4 to 12, with the best entertainers, elaborate decor and a unique programme for every theme.
birthdays.boys: Action parties for ages 4 to 12: gaming and virtual reality, ninja extreme, superheroes and a football tournament.
birthdays.girls: Magical concepts for ages 4 to 12: boutique spa, pop-star karaoke with a red carpet, DIY workshops and a fairy and unicorn party.
